privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: Three things you can do with your own data: create an export, share documents, and ask for your account to be deleted.
privacy.delete.heading: Delete account
privacy.delete.explain: The request is recorded straight away, but the deletion is not finished when you press the button. Access you had shared is revoked and the account moves to pending deletion.
privacy.delete.legalPending: The catalogue of what is erased and what must be kept by law is still with the lawyers. Until that is signed off, do not read this as the final description.
privacy.delete.reauthNote: Because this cannot be undone, your session must have been issued within the last 5 minutes.
privacy.delete.requestId.label: Request id
privacy.delete.requestId.hint: 8 to 128 characters. Sending the same id again returns the same receipt instead of making a second request.
privacy.delete.confirm.label: Type DELETE to confirm
privacy.delete.pendingHeading: Not finished. These steps are still outstanding:
privacy.delete.pending.append_only_erasu: Erasing personal content held in append-only tables
privacy.delete.pending.identity_verifica: Verifying the identity of the requester
privacy.delete.pending.tombstone_registr: The deleted-account registry, held outside backups
